BiblicalUsage: Seneh is the thorn bush, and it is remembered for one blazing moment. Moses turned aside to look at a bush that burned without burning up, and out of the middle of it God called him by name. Years later, when Moses blessed Joseph, he still spoke of the good will of him that dwelt in the bush, as if that fire had never left him.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God chose the lowliest thing in the desert to carry His presence — a thorn bush, not a cedar. That tells me He is not looking for impressive vessels; He is looking for ground that will burn without being consumed.
